source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda c: sum(row.count(c) for row in grid))
    colors = set(x for row in grid for x in row if x != background)
    for color in colors:
        for r1 in range(h):
            for r2 in range(r1 + 2, h):
                for c1 in range(w):
                    for c2 in range(c1 + 2, w):
                        if (all(grid[r1][c] == color and grid[r2][c] == color for c in range(c1, c2 + 1))
                                and all(grid[r][c1] == color and grid[r][c2] == color for r in range(r1, r2 + 1))):
                            for r in range(r1 + 1, r2):
                                for c in range(c1 + 1, c2):
                                    out[r][c] = 4
    return out
'''
